name: Hub problem
about: Report a family link, catalog, compatibility or artwork problem
---

Describe the expected and observed result. Include the affected hub path or link, revision, harness/product version and a minimal redacted reproducer.

State whether this used a local checkout, packed archive, registry package or marketplace. Product runtime bugs belong in the product repository. Do not include private files, account information, credentials or full agent transcripts. Follow SECURITY.md for sensitive reports.
